---
title: smalldocs 0.3.1
subtitle: Double dollars in a sentence are display maths
date: 2026-10-16
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

Maths between double dollars inside a sentence, such as `Text $$x = 1$$ more text.`, is now display maths
on a line of its own, as in Quarto. Before, smalldocs drew it as inline maths. Double dollars on a line of
their own were already right. See [Maths](../guide/markdown.qmd#maths).

The documentation has moved to [docs.smallish.dev](https://docs.smallish.dev/).
